Legal & Compliance (NEEDS LEGAL REVIEW)

Privacy Policy & Data Protection Notice

Effective Date: November 2026 • Formulated in adherence with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP Act) and Information Technology (SPDI) Rules.

Compliance Status: This privacy notice outlines data minimization, purpose limitation, and consent principles. Specific clinic clauses remain [TBD:privacy_notice] pending formal legal review.

1. Data Fiduciary Identity

The Data Fiduciary responsible for processing your digital personal and health data under this policy is [TBD:clinic_legal_name], operating as [TBD:clinic_brand], having its clinic premises at [TBD:clinic_address], Thane, Maharashtra, India.

2. Categories of Data Collected

We collect only data necessary for clinical care and booking administration:

  • Demographic Data: Full name, date of birth, gender, residential address.
  • Contact Data: Verified mobile number (for DLT SMS / OTP transactional notices) and email address.
  • Clinical Records: Intraoral scans, digital radiographs (RVG/OPG), medical history, allergies, clinical notes, and treatment plans recorded by registered dentists.
  • Billing Records: Invoice identifiers, payment mode, transaction receipts (PCI-DSS compliant hosted payment flows).

3. Purpose Limitation & Consent

Personal and clinical data are processed strictly for defined purposes: scheduling consultations, diagnosing dental conditions, executing authorized surgical procedures, delivering payment receipts, and fulfilling statutory medical record-keeping mandates. We do not sell, rent, or trade patient personal data. We never train machine learning or AI models on patient clinical records.

4. Clinical Imagery & Smile Gallery Consent

Under Dental Council of India regulations and DPDP Act provisions, any clinical photography or transformation imagery displayed on this platform requires prior, specific, freely given, and recorded written consent. Every public gallery item references an auditable consent record. Patients maintain the unconditional right to withdraw image consent at any time.

5. Data Retention & Security

Clinical health records are retained in compliance with applicable medical establishment regulations. Digital communications and access logs are protected using TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, AES-256 encryption at rest, and least-privilege role-based access control (RBAC).

6. Patient Data Rights

Under the DPDP Act 2023, you have the right to:

  • Access a summary of your personal data processed by the clinic.
  • Request correction, completion, or updating of inaccurate personal data.
  • Request erasure of personal data that is no longer required for statutory medical or billing retention.
  • Nominate an individual to exercise rights in the event of death or incapacity.

7. Grievance Redressal

For questions regarding data processing or to exercise your rights under the DPDP Act, contact our designated Data Grievance Officer:
